subject: PO enforcement and invoice cadence impact on tiered discount
messages:
From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@stratuslabs.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@stratuslabs.com
Date: Sat, 4 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PO reference requirement and invoice-split impact on our discount

Sean —

Quick one from procurement: our AP team requires a PO reference on every invoice line for any vendor. For deals like ours (volume-based tiered discount) we typically split invoices across multiple payment runs (weekly) for cashflow forecasting. Two questions for Redwood: 1) If we split the monthly billed amount into weekly invoices that each reference the same PO, will we still qualify for the monthly tiered discount (i.e., does Redwood evaluate discounts on a monthly rolling total or per-invoice?), and 2) what PO field / format do you need so our ERP can auto-match?

We attached our PO template (Stratus_PO_Template.pdf) and the AP policy (Stratus_AP_Policy.docx) so you can see constraints. Also, our legal asks that we keep Net45 on the contract.

We'd like a short call early next week to confirm — procurement + AP on our side will join.

Thanks,
Laura Chen
Senior Procurement Manager
Stratus Labs

Attachment: Stratus_PO_Template.pdf (application/pdf, 98KB)
Attachment: Stratus_AP_Policy.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document, 64KB)

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@stratuslabs.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 4 Jul 2026 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO reference requirement and invoice-split impact on our discount

Laura —

Thanks for the clear background and the policy / PO template. Short answers up front: we can support weekly invoice releases referencing the same master PO and still honor the volume discount, provided the monthly aggregated billed amount meets the slab thresholds in the agreement. The matching we need is: a parent PO ID on each invoice (exact string match), plus a small set of line metadata (internal SKU or ledger tag, and invoice "month-of-service" field) so your ERP can reconcile to the monthly statement.

Notes and follow-ups:
- We usually evaluate discounts on a calendar-month aggregation (not per invoice). That means weekly invoices are fine so long as their sum for the month hits the tier.
- For Net45 we can keep standard terms; our finance team will include Net45 on each invoice. If you need prepayment or committed credit to guarantee pricing, we can discuss a reserved-commit path (Dedicated) but that shouldn't be necessary for standard volume discounts.
- PO format: we can accept your PO template as-is if the PO ID shows up in the header and on each invoice line. Alternatively, we can provide a narrow mapping file (CSV) to show the fields we will populate for ERPs that need exact column names. I attached a quick mapping proposal (PO-mapping-proposal.csv).

Next steps:
1) Kimberly/Vanessa — can you confirm finance & billing can produce a monthly rollup (single monthly statement) in addition to weekly invoice files? If yes, we'll send a sample invoice and a sample monthly statement for Stratus AP to validate with their ERP team.
2) Laura — are you available for a 30-min sync on Monday 7/6 at 10am PT? We'll include finance (Kimberly) and account ops (Vanessa).

I'll wait for the confirmation and will circulate the sample invoice.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Director, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: PO-mapping-proposal.csv (text/csv, 2KB)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 5 Jul 2026 08:31:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO reference requirement and invoice-split impact on our discount

Sean / Vanessa —

Quick internal note for the thread before the Monday call. Finance can absolutely emit weekly invoice files that each reference the parent PO ID and include line-level ledger tags. A couple of practical constraints and options:

1) Discount evaluation: we currently compute discounts on a per-customer calendar-month aggregation in our billing system. That is system-enforced so we won't lose the slab if weekly invoices total the monthly band.

2) Matching fields: the minimum set we need on each invoice is "PO ID", "Invoice line GL code" (or SKU), and "Service month". If Stratus ERP requires a different column name, the CSV mapping Sean attached is the right way to get a reliable mapping.

3) Monthly rollup: we can produce a consolidated monthly statement (PDF and CSV) that lists the weekly invoices and the aggregated totals for the month. That is what I'd surface to Stratus AP as the canonical record for discount qualification.

4) Edge case: if Stratus applies payment at the invoice level (i.e., they remit against a single weekly invoice and keep others unpaid until next run), discounts technically still apply because our slab is aggregated. However, credit memos / short pays will require manual reconciliation; recommend a short SLA (10 business days) to resolve any short-pay exceptions to avoid collection flags.

I'll join the Monday call and bring a sample invoice and the monthly rollup attachment (sample-invoice-redwood-202607.pdf).

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Head of Finance, Redwood Inference

Attachment: sample-invoice-redwood-202607.pdf (application/pdf, 46KB)

From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@stratuslabs.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 5 Jul 2026 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO reference requirement and invoice-split impact on our discount

Thanks all — this is very helpful. Monday 7/6 10am PT works for procurement + AP leads on our side. We'll review the PO template and mapping you attached and test the sample invoice in our ERP sandbox after the call. A few items we'll bring to the meeting:

- Our auto-match rules (we require exact PO ID match or the invoice is flagged)
- Any limitations on accepted invoice file formats (we prefer CSV for EDI ingestion)
- Confirmation that the monthly rollup PDF + CSV will be considered the official record for discount calculations (sounds like yes from Kim)

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Joining from my side: Laura Chen (procurement), Miguel Torres (AP Director, procurement@stratuslabs.com).

Looking forward to the call — please send a calendar invite with a dial-in and the sample files.

Laura
